relationships.subject: Icariside II
relationships.evidence_quote: Icariside II (ICA-II), one of the flavonols studied, inhibited the biochemical interactions between USP5 and Cav3.2 and concomitantly and effectively blocked Cav3.2 channels.

relationships.subject: Icariside II
relationships.evidence_quote: ICA-II inhibited both phases of the formalin-induced nocifensive responses and abolished thermal hyperalgesia induced by injection of complete Freund's adjuvant (CFA) into the hind paw.

key_findings: Icariside II blocks Cav3.2 and disrupts USP5-Cav3.2 interaction, producing analgesia in inflammatory and neuropathic pain models.
Cav3.2 null mice were resistant to ICA-II.
